disambiguation: It is a visual mind map editor that operates directly on Markdown outline files.
extras: Desktop only; operates entirely locally without network calls or telemetry.
intentEvidence: Simple Mind turns a plain .mindmap file into a polished, interactive map — and keeps it a plain Markdown outline underneath.
problem: Users need a way to visualize and interact with Markdown outlines as mind maps without losing the underlying plain text structure or relying on external tools.
summary: Simple Mind is a Markdown-outline mind map editor that converts plain text outlines into interactive visual maps while maintaining the original Markdown source.
